issues.description: Method de.tum.in.ase.eist.rest.PersonResource#getAllPersons: In the template repository this handler method is declared public (public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()), while in the solution repository it is declared private (private ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()). This visibility mismatch between template and solution may confuse students about the expected access modifier for controller request-handling methods and could cause uncertainty about whether non-public handler methods are supported by the framework.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of PersonResource#getAllPersons consistent. Change the solution implementation signature to public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons() so it matches the template and the common expectation that controller handler methods are public.
